Gentile Arena]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2016–17 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team''' represented [[Loyola University Chicago]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Ramblers, led by sixth-year head coach [[Porter Moser]], played their home games at the [[Joseph J. Gentile Arena]] in [[Chicago, Illinois]] as members of the [[Missouri Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 18–14, 8–10 in [[2016–17 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|MVC play]] to finish in fifth place. They lost to [[2016–17 Southern Illinois Salukis men's basketball team|Southern Illinois]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2017 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Ramblers]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 15–17, 7–11 in Missouri Valley play to finish in eighth play. They defeated [[2015–16 Bradley Braves men's basketball team|Bradley]] in the first round of the [[2016 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|Missouri Valley tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
